context: Evaluates whether the agent correctly implements a Terraform data source and adds import state support to an existing resource, with proper diagnostics and acceptance tests.

checklist.name: Data source schema
checklist.description: Data source has id as Required String and name as Computed String. Both attributes have Description strings

checklist.name: Data source Read method
checklist.description: Data source Read method gets config, looks up the item, handles not-found by adding an error diagnostic (not returning silently), and sets complete state on success

checklist.name: Data source diagnostics
checklist.description: Config.Get and State.Set calls in the data source are followed by resp.Diagnostics.HasError() checks with early returns

checklist.name: Import state interface
checklist.description: The example_resource implements the ResourceWithImportState interface by adding an ImportState method

checklist.name: ImportStatePassthroughID
checklist.description: The ImportState method uses resource.ImportStatePassthroughID with the correct attribute path for id

checklist.name: Data source acceptance test
checklist.description: Test uses resource.Test with a TestStep that creates a resource as a dependency, then reads it via the data source using a reference to the resource's id attribute

checklist.name: Import test step
checklist.description: Resource test includes a TestStep with ImportState: true and ImportStateVerify: true that verifies the resource can be imported by ID

checklist.name: Provider registration
checklist.description: Data source is registered in provider.go's DataSources() method

checklist.name: Test uses ProtoV6ProviderFactories
checklist.description: Tests use ProtoV6ProviderFactories (not ProviderFactories) appropriate for terraform-plugin-framework
